messages.snippet: Richard, Karen, Bartlett opened at £290k, PMI 12 months, costs £2k, covenants removed. After a call
messages.subject: WC-00130 - negotiation update
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard, Karen,

Bartlett opened at £290k, PMI 12 months, costs £2k, covenants removed. After a call we have a realistic landing zone of £240-250k inclusive, PMI 6 months, costs £1.5k, covenants reduced to 9 months (not removed). That is within the envelope in our advice note and well below the worst-case exposure.

My recommendation is to authorise £247,500 as a round figure and hold the covenant reduction at nine months. Are you content for me to put that to Bartlett?

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
T: 020 7946 0021

messages.subject: RE: WC-00130 - negotiation update
messages.plaintextBody:
Agreed - £247,500 inclusive on those terms. The Board meets on 22 April and we'll get formal sign-off then but you have our authority to agree subject to contract in the meantime. Keep the covenants at nine months; the Helix/Greaves overlap matters to us.

Richard
